name: eBay Canada Seller
description: Manage eBay Canada seller listings, inventory, policies, orders, and offers through eBay API actions.

display_description.en: Read eBay Canada listings, inventory, orders and offers, and manage seller actions through eBay APIs.
display_description.zh: 查看 eBay 加拿大站点的商品、库存、订单和报价，并通过 eBay API 管理卖家操作。

default_init_input.en: Which of my eBay Best Offers and buyer counteroffers need a response?
default_init_input.zh: 我的哪些 eBay 买家报价和还价需要回复？

quick_inputs.en: Which of my eBay Best Offers and buyer counteroffers need a response?
quick_inputs.zh: 我的哪些 eBay 买家报价和还价需要回复？

quick_inputs.en: Show my active listings and inventory.
quick_inputs.zh: 显示我正在销售的商品和库存。

quick_inputs.en: Show my shipping, payment, and return policies.
quick_inputs.zh: 显示我的物流、付款和退货政策。

display_description.en: Read seller account, feedback, listings, inventory, orders, policies, offers, and category information.
display_description.zh: 读取卖家账户、评价、商品、库存、订单、政策、报价和类别信息。

display_description.en: Create business policies, manage inventory and offers, and revise or end listings.
display_description.zh: 创建商业政策、管理库存和报价，以及修改或结束商品。

display_description.en: Respond to Best Offers or send offers to interested buyers.
display_description.zh: 回复买家报价，或向有意向的买家发送报价。
